checked_by: Claude Code (three recon subagents, reviewed by the session)
purpose: Access-policy recon for platforms the scripted market monitor cannot read. Fact-finding only; no platform is enabled by this file.
method: Fetched only robots.txt, terms, help/FAQ pages, homepages and (where robots allowed) one category page per dealer, with the project research user agent or WebFetch. No search-results URL on a robots-disallowed path, no login, no form, no account. Raw responses and a fetch log are kept privately in data/private/monitoring/market/recon-2026-10-04/.
recon_rule_breaches: Trocadero: curl followed a 307 into /php/_xsite/doPOW.php (a bot-check page); robots.txt disallows /php/. One request.
Jasper52: jasper52.com/robots.txt 301-redirected to the chairish-auctions.liveauctioneers.com homepage, a host whose robots.txt disallows /. One request, unintended.
Barakat (7) and Apollo (8, two of them failed DNS lookups) exceeded the roughly six-requests-per-site cap.
